about: The load-failure contract (the restructure, step 2, 2026-11-26; RESTRUCTURE-PLAN.md section 6): what one page file that cannot be loaded may take down.
Every page script in index.html is listed with its class and its feature group; tests/modload.test.js checks it (404 of each file on Chromium and WebKit, and the imports read from the files).

on404: what its 404 shows where that is not its class's usual: "card" (the start-up card), "no-picture" (Today drawn without its outfit figure), "picture" (Today drawn with it: the mannequin or the painted picture) or "painted" (Today drawn, its only figure the painted picture: "picture" once painted, "no-picture" where the painter is late or does not paint); a string for both engines, or {chromium, webkit}.

required.what: the app cannot start without it: its failure may show the start-up card. It may import only required files.

today-no-picture.what: without it Today is drawn with no outfit picture, never the start-up card. It may import required and today-no-picture files, never an optional one.

optional.what: only its feature is lost (its group may fail together); Today is drawn with its picture. It may import required and today-no-picture files and the files of its own group. No required or today-no-picture file imports it: they reach it through bus.js (an announcement, or a socket: serve/ask).

groups.today: Today and the plan behind it
groups.painter: the outfit picture: drawn figure, mannequin poses, the painter
groups.add: the Add page and its readings
groups.item-sheet: the item sheet and the Wardrobe grid
groups.backup: sync, its photos and status, snapshots, backup files
groups.(a file's own name): a feature that is one file

who.js.note: who is connected (from account.js and sync-status.js, the restructure S3b)

photo-keys.js.note: the photo keys and the kept pictures (from photos.js, the restructure S3b): as photos.js, without it Today has no outfit picture

mannequin.js.note: without it Today has no mannequin: its only figure is the painted picture, there once the painter has painted (late on a busy machine; not on Windows WebKit, whose healthy page showed no painted picture in the lab survey)

mq/vest.js.note: as mannequin.js: without the pose of the day's outfit Today has only the painted picture; modload holds the day on Monday 2026-11-16, whose outfit has a vest (on Thursday 2026-11-26 it is mq/suit.js)

act.js.note: required by the owner's choice (c): as toast.js; Settings does not open without it

days.js.note: the day records (from history.js, the restructure S3b): as history.js, without it Today has no outfit picture

toast.js.note: required by the owner's choice (c), 2026-11-25: a later import of it may show the start-up card; today its 404 shows Today with its picture

ui.js.note: required by the owner's choice (c) (its questions): as toast.js

asm-keys.js.note: the color-coded masters' version, kinds and keys (from asm-color.js, the restructure S4): assemble.js and draw.js read it, and without it Today has no outfit picture (measured on both engines)

sync.js.note: as mannequin.js: without it Today has only the painted picture

calparse.js.note: not a page script: calendar.js imports it with import() when a calendar is read
